verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe installing via GitHub/GitLab, automated PR reviews within 5 minutes (greptile-docs-5), and native review comments with actionable buttons (greptile-docs-1, greptile-docs-2, greptile-docs-36). Community testimony (greptile-comm-8) corroborates real-world use catching issues on PRs, but other community reports describe reliability issues (stuck processing, internal errors) with the underlying platform, and no independent source specifically confirms the 'minutes to install' claim or inline-comment UX end-to-end. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of install speed and native inline-comment rendering, and resolution of community-reported reliability issues.
